sources.excerpt: Ceer Motors unveils the EXOBOT SUV and sedan in Saudi Arabia, its first electric vehicles in the country.
Ceer Motors is a Saudi Arabian electric vehicle brand that makes sedans and SUVs for the GCC region.
The name "Ceer" means "drive forward" in Arabic.
New Zealand's critically endangered black robin wins Forest & Bird's Bird of the Year competition with more than 26,000 votes out of about 105,000 votes.

There are around 390 black robins as of 2026, but in 1980 only five survived on Little Mangere Island. They were saved from extinction by Don Merton and his Wildlife Service team, and by "Old Blue", the last remaining fertile female.
The black robin or Chatham Island robin (Moriori: karure, Māori: kakaruia; Petroica traversi) is an endangered bird from the Chatham Islands off the east coast of New Zealand.
An amateur astronomer scouting campsites accidentally uncovered a massive 390-million-year-old impact crater hidden in the Quebec wilderness.

Researchers discovered shatter cones in numerous rock outcrops. These distinctive structures form under the intense pressures produced during an impact and provided compelling evidence that the feature was not volcanic after all.
The object responsible for the collision was powerful enough to produce a complex crater structure measuring about 25 kilometers (16 miles) across.
